class.name: RosServerGoalHandle
class.brief_description: The server-side handle for an accepted action goal.

method.name: abort
method.description: Terminates the goal as failed, sending [param result] to the client (the client sees [constant RosGoalHandle.STATUS_ABORTED]).

method.name: canceled
method.description: Terminates the goal as canceled, sending [param result] to the client (the client sees [constant RosGoalHandle.STATUS_CANCELED]). Call this in response to [method is_cancel_requested] becoming [code]true[/code].

method.name: create_feedback
method.description: Creates and returns an empty [RosMsg] of this action's feedback type, ready to be filled and passed to [method publish_feedback].

method.name: create_result
method.description: Creates and returns an empty [RosMsg] of this action's result type, ready to be filled and passed to one of the terminal methods.

method.name: get_goal
method.description: Returns the goal message sent by the client.

method.name: get_goal_id
method.description: Returns the unique identifier of this goal as a hexadecimal string. Useful for logging when handling several concurrent goals.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the goal has not reached a terminal state yet.

method.name: is_cancel_requested
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once a client has requested this goal to be canceled. Poll it inside long-running execute callbacks and finish with [method canceled].

method.name: publish_feedback
method.description: Publishes a [param feedback] message for this goal. Clients receive it through the [signal RosGoalHandle.feedback] signal.

method.name: succeed
method.description: Terminates the goal successfully, sending [param result] to the client (the client sees [constant RosGoalHandle.STATUS_SUCCEEDED]).
